name: Version 2.1.16
body:
**Data flow fixes:**

1. Fix of issue #45: Transfering Runecloth from guild bank to bag for Heavy Runecloth Bandage caused an error in the function `ATSW_TooltipSetSkill`
2. Fix of issue #47: Showing a recipe for non-existent skill caused an error in the function `SelectCraftItem`
